<Heading

  children={"Pull the same remote path from every host in a fleet"}
>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugin-api/fleets/{id}/transfer/pull"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs on up to 10 hosts at a time, across every effective member host the caller has edit-level access to, reads remotePath via SFTP from each, and returns a single zip archive with one entry per successful host `(<hostName>-<hostId>/<filename>).` Single file only, up to 200 MB per host.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"path","name":"id","required":true,"schema":{"type":"integer"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"remotePath":{"type":"string"}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"Zip archive containing the per-host pulled files, plus an X-Fleet-Transfer-Results header with the per-host JSON result summary."},"404":{"description":"Fleet not found."}}}
>
  
</StatusCodes>
